changes.before: Abishai, the brother of Yoav, he was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
changes.after: Avishai, the brother of Yoav, he was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

changes.before: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
changes.after: Eliel, and Oved, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

changes.before: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Menashe, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Menashe.
changes.after: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Menashe, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Mikha'el, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Menashe.

changes.before: Dawid was displeased, because YHWH had broken forth on Uzza; and he called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
changes.after: Dawid was displeased, because YHWH had broken forth on Uzza; and he called that place Peretz Uzza, to this day.

changes.before: So Dawid didn't move the ark to him into the city of Dawid, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
changes.after: So Dawid didn't move the ark to him into the city of Dawid, but carried it aside into the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite.

changes.before: The ark of Elohim remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months: and YHWH blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that he had.
changes.after: The ark of Elohim remained with the family of Oved-Edom in his house three months: and YHWH blessed the house of Oved-Edom, and all that he had.

changes.before: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
changes.after: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadav the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

changes.before: Dawid called for Tzadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
changes.after: Dawid called for Tzadok and Evyatar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadav,

changes.before: and with them their brothers of the second degree, Zekharyah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benayahu, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
changes.after: and with them their brothers of the second degree, Zekharyah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benayahu, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Oved-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

changes.before: and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
changes.after: and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Oved-Edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

changes.before: Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethanel, and Amasai, and Zekharyah, and Benayahu, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow the trumpets before the ark of Elohim: and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
changes.after: Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethanel, and Amasai, and Zekharyah, and Benayahu, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow the trumpets before the ark of Elohim: and Oved-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

changes.before: So Dawid, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of YHWH out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
changes.after: So Dawid, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of YHWH out of the house of Oved-Edom with joy.

changes.before: saying, I will you give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,
changes.after: saying, I will you give the land of Kena'an, The lot of your inheritance,

changes.before: and Obed-Edom with their brothers, sixty-eight; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
changes.after: and Oved-Edom with their brothers, sixty-eight; Oved-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

changes.before: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zekharyah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benayahu, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
changes.after: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zekharyah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benayahu, and Oved-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

changes.before: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt eighteen thousand.
changes.after: Moreover Avishai the son of Zeruiah struck of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt eighteen thousand.

changes.before: and Tzadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
changes.after: and Tzadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Evyatar, were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

changes.before: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
changes.after: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Avishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

changes.before: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Yoav came to Yerushalayim.
changes.after: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Avishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Yoav came to Yerushalayim.

changes.before: Canaan became the father of Tzidon his firstborn, and Heth,
changes.after: Kena'an became the father of Tzidon his firstborn, and Heth,

changes.before: Abram (the same is Avraham).
changes.after: Avram (the same is Avraham).

changes.before: The sons of Avraham: Yitzhak, and Ishmael.
changes.after: The sons of Avraham: Yitzhak, and Yishmael.

changes.before: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
changes.after: These are their generations: the firstborn of Yishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

changes.before: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
changes.after: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Yishmael.

changes.before: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
changes.after: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerach, Shammah, and Mizzah.

changes.before: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
changes.after: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerach of Bozrah reigned in his place.

changes.before: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
changes.after: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Kena'an.

changes.before: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
changes.after: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Aviyah,

changes.before: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, and the princes, and Tzadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers' house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
changes.after: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, and the princes, and Tzadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Evyatar, and the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers' house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

changes.before: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
changes.after: To Oved-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

changes.before: His brothers: of Eliezer [came] Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
changes.after: His brothers: of Eliezer [came] Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Yoram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

changes.before: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth,
changes.after: Oved-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth,

changes.before: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brothers were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
changes.after: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Oved, Elzabad, whose brothers were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

changes.before: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom: they and their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service; sixty-two of Obed-Edom.
changes.after: All these were of the sons of Oved-Edom: they and their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service; sixty-two of Oved-Edom.

changes.before: of Yehudah, Elihu, one of the brothers of Dawid: of Yissakhar, Omri the son of Michael:
changes.after: of Yehudah, Elihu, one of the brothers of Dawid: of Yissakhar, Omri the son of Mikha'el:

changes.before: Over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers, was Yonatan the son of Uzziah:
changes.after: Over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers, was Yonatan the son of Uzziyah:

changes.before: [He was] of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
changes.after: [He was] of the children of Peretz, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

changes.before: and after Ahithophel was Yehoyada the son of Benayahu, and Abiathar: and the captain of the king's army was Yoav.
changes.after: and after Ahithophel was Yehoyada the son of Benayahu, and Evyatar: and the captain of the king's army was Yoav.

changes.before: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Yehudah;
changes.after: Ram became the father of Amminadav, and Amminadav became the father of Nachshon, prince of the children of Yehudah;

changes.before: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
changes.after: and Nachshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

changes.before: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Yishai;
changes.after: and Boaz became the father of Oved, and Oved became the father of Yishai;

changes.before: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Yoav, and Asahel, three.
changes.after: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Avishai, and Yoav, and Asahel, three.

changes.before: Kalev the son of Hezron became the father of [children] of Azubah [his] wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
changes.after: Kalev the son of Chetzron became the father of [children] of Azubah [his] wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

changes.before: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took [as wife] when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
changes.after: Afterward Chetzron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took [as wife] when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

changes.before: After that Hezron was dead in Kalev Ephrathah, then Abijah Hezron's wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
changes.after: After that Chetzron was dead in Kalev Ephrathah, then Aviyah Chetzron's wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

changes.before: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
changes.after: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Chetzron were Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.

changes.before: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
changes.after: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Oved,

changes.before: and Obed became the father of Yehu, and Yehu became the father of Azaryah,
changes.after: and Oved became the father of Yehu, and Yehu became the father of Azaryah,

changes.before: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Yehudah were five.
changes.after: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Peretz and Zerach. All the sons of Yehudah were five.

changes.before: The sons of Perez: Hezron, and Hamul.
changes.after: The sons of Peretz: Chetzron, and Hamul.

changes.before: Salma the father of Beit Lechem, Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
changes.after: Salma the father of Beit Lechem, Hareph the father of Beit Gader.

changes.before: The sons of Salma: Beit Lechem, and the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Yoav, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
changes.after: The sons of Salma: Beit Lechem, and the Netophathites, Atrot Beit Yoav, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

changes.before: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.
changes.after: The sons of Zerach: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.

changes.before: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
changes.after: The sons also of Chetzron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

changes.before: Shlomo's son was Rechavam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Yehoshafat his son,
changes.after: Shlomo's son was Rechavam, Aviyah his son, Asa his son, Yehoshafat his son,

changes.before: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Yoash his son,
changes.after: Yoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Yoash his son,

changes.before: Amaziah his son, Azaryah his son, Jotham his son,
changes.after: Amaziah his son, Azaryah his son, Yotam his son,

changes.before: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Tzidkiyahu his son.
changes.after: The sons of Jehoiakim: Yekhonyahu his son, Tzidkiyahu his son.

changes.before: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
changes.after: The sons of Yekhonyahu, the captive: She'altiel his son,

changes.before: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
changes.after: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubavel, and Shimei. The sons of Zerubavel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

changes.before: the third, Avshalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
changes.after: the third, Avshalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adoniyahu the son of Haggith;

changes.before: The sons of Yehudah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
changes.after: The sons of Yehudah: Peretz, Chetzron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

changes.before: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
changes.after: Eshton became the father of Beit Rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

changes.before: The sons of Shim'on: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
changes.after: The sons of Shim'on: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerach, Shaul;

changes.before: and at Beth Marcaboth, and Hazar Susim, and at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities to the reign of Dawid.
changes.after: and at Beit Markavot, and Hazar Susim, and at Beit Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities to the reign of Dawid.

changes.before: Their brothers of their fathers' houses: Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.
changes.after: Their brothers of their fathers' houses: Mikha'el, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.

changes.before: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
changes.after: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Mikha'el, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

changes.before: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Yehudah, and in the days of Yerovam king of Israel.
changes.after: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Yotam king of Yehudah, and in the days of Yerovam king of Israel.

changes.before: the sons of Reuven the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
changes.after: the sons of Reuven the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Chetzron, and Carmi.

changes.before: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
changes.after: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerach his son, Jeatherai his son.

changes.before: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
changes.after: The sons of Kohath: Amminadav his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

changes.before: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
changes.after: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziyah his son, and Shaul his son.

changes.before: The sons of Shmuel: the firstborn [Joel], and the second Abijah.
changes.after: The sons of Shmuel: the firstborn [Joel], and the second Aviyah.

changes.before: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
changes.after: Eleazar became the father of Pinchas, Pinchas became the father of Abishua,

changes.before: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
changes.after: the son of Mikha'el, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

changes.before: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
changes.after: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerach, the son of Adaiah,

changes.before: These are the sons of Aharon: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
changes.after: These are the sons of Aharon: Eleazar his son, Pinchas his son, Abishua his son,

changes.before: and Ashan with its suburbs, and Beth Shemesh with its suburbs;
changes.after: and Ashan with its suburbs, and Beit Shemesh with its suburbs;

changes.before: and Jokmeam with its suburbs, and Beth Horon with its suburbs,
changes.after: and Jokmeam with its suburbs, and Beit Horon with its suburbs,

changes.before: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
changes.after: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beit Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

changes.before: and by the borders of the children of Menashe, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the children of Yosef the son of Israel.
changes.after: and by the borders of the children of Menashe, Beit She'an and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the children of Yosef the son of Israel.

changes.before: The sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
changes.after: The sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Mikha'el, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

changes.before: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Yoash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
changes.after: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Yoash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Aviyah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

changes.before: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah,
changes.after: and Mikha'el, and Ishpah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah,

changes.before: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
changes.after: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Yishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

changes.before: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, [and] YHWH was with him.
changes.after: Pinchas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, [and] YHWH was with him.

changes.before: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Yehudah.
changes.after: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Peretz the son of Yehudah.

changes.before: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
changes.after: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Yishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

changes.before: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
changes.after: Of the sons of Zerach: Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

changes.before: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Master, together with the assembly that is in their house.
changes.after: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Akylas and Priskilla greet you much in the Master, together with the assembly that is in their house.

changes.before: At that time Abijah the son of Yerovam fell sick.
changes.after: At that time Aviyah the son of Yerovam fell sick.

changes.before: Then Natan spoke to Bat-Sheva the mother of Shlomo, saying, Haven't you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and Dawid our lord doesn't know it?
changes.after: Then Natan spoke to Bat-Sheva the mother of Shlomo, saying, Haven't you heard that Adoniyahu the son of Haggith reigns, and Dawid our lord doesn't know it?

changes.before: Go and get you in to king Dawid, and tell him, Didn't you, my lord, king, swear to your handmaid, saying, Assuredly Shlomo your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne? why then does Adonijah reign?
changes.after: Go and get you in to king Dawid, and tell him, Didn't you, my lord, king, swear to your handmaid, saying, Assuredly Shlomo your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne? why then does Adoniyahu reign?

changes.before: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don't know it:
changes.after: Now, behold, Adoniyahu reigns; and you, my lord the king, don't know it:

changes.before: and he has slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Yoav the captain of the army; but he hasn't called Shlomo your servant.
changes.after: and he has slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, and Evyatar the priest, and Yoav the captain of the army; but he hasn't called Shlomo your servant.

changes.before: Natan said, My lord, king, have you said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne?
changes.after: Natan said, My lord, king, have you said, Adoniyahu shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne?

changes.before: For he is gone down this day, and has slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king's sons, and the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest; and behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and say, [Long] live king Adonijah.
changes.after: For he is gone down this day, and has slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king's sons, and the captains of the army, and Evyatar the priest; and behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and say, [Long] live king Adoniyahu.

changes.before: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. When Yoav heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
changes.after: Adoniyahu and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. When Yoav heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

changes.before: While he yet spoke, behold, Yonatan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said, Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.
changes.after: While he yet spoke, behold, Yonatan the son of Evyatar the priest came: and Adoniyahu said, Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.

changes.before: Yonatan answered Adonijah, Most certainly our lord king Dawid has made Shlomo king:
changes.after: Yonatan answered Adoniyahu, Most certainly our lord king Dawid has made Shlomo king:

changes.before: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went everyone their way.
changes.after: All the guests of Adoniyahu were afraid, and rose up, and went everyone their way.

changes.before: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
changes.after: Then Adoniyahu the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

changes.before: Adonijah feared because of Shlomo; and he arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
changes.after: Adoniyahu feared because of Shlomo; and he arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

changes.before: It was told Shlomo, saying, Behold, Adonijah fears king Shlomo; for, behold, he has laid hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Shlomo swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.
changes.after: It was told Shlomo, saying, Behold, Adoniyahu fears king Shlomo; for, behold, he has laid hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Shlomo swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.

changes.before: He conferred with Yoav the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
changes.after: He conferred with Yoav the son of Zeruiah, and with Evyatar the priest: and they following Adoniyahu helped him.

changes.before: But Tzadok the priest, and Benayahu the son of Yehoyada, and Natan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty people who belonged to Dawid, were not with Adonijah.
changes.after: But Tzadok the priest, and Benayahu the son of Yehoyada, and Natan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty people who belonged to Dawid, were not with Adoniyahu.

changes.before: Adonijah killed sheep and oxen and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king's sons, and all the people of Yehudah, the king's servants:
changes.after: Adoniyahu killed sheep and oxen and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king's sons, and all the people of Yehudah, the king's servants:

changes.before: Yehoshafat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid his father; Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
changes.after: Yehoshafat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid his father; Yoram his son reigned in his place.

changes.before: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bat-Sheva the mother of Shlomo. She said, Come you peaceably? He said, Peaceably.
changes.after: Then Adoniyahu the son of Haggith came to Bat-Sheva the mother of Shlomo. She said, Come you peaceably? He said, Peaceably.

changes.before: Bat-Sheva therefore went to king Shlomo, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
changes.after: Bat-Sheva therefore went to king Shlomo, to speak to him for Adoniyahu. The king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

changes.before: She said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.
changes.after: She said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adoniyahu your brother as wife.

changes.before: King Shlomo answered his mother, Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Yoav the son of Zeruiah.
changes.after: King Shlomo answered his mother, Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adoniyahu? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Evyatar the priest, and for Yoav the son of Zeruiah.

changes.before: Then king Shlomo swore by YHWH, saying, Elohim do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.
changes.after: Then king Shlomo swore by YHWH, saying, Elohim do so to me, and more also, if Adoniyahu has not spoken this word against his own life.

changes.before: Now therefore as YHWH lives, who has established me, and set me on the throne of Dawid my father, and who has made me a house, as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
changes.after: Now therefore as YHWH lives, who has established me, and set me on the throne of Dawid my father, and who has made me a house, as he promised, surely Adoniyahu shall be put to death this day.

changes.before: To Abiathar the priest said the king, Get you to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you bear the ark of YHWH God before Dawid my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.
changes.after: To Evyatar the priest said the king, Get you to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you bear the ark of YHWH God before Dawid my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.

changes.before: So Shlomo thrust out Abiathar from being priest to YHWH, that he might fulfill the word of YHWH, which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shilo.
changes.after: So Shlomo thrust out Evyatar from being priest to YHWH, that he might fulfill the word of YHWH, which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shilo.

changes.before: The news came to Yoav; for Yoav had turned after Adonijah, though he didn't turn after Avshalom. Yoav fled to the Tent of YHWH, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
changes.after: The news came to Yoav; for Yoav had turned after Adoniyahu, though he didn't turn after Avshalom. Yoav fled to the Tent of YHWH, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

changes.before: The king put Benayahu the son of Yehoyada in his room over the army; and Tzadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
changes.after: The king put Benayahu the son of Yehoyada in his room over the army; and Tzadok the priest did the king put in the room of Evyatar.

changes.before: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
changes.after: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beit She'an which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beit She'an to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

changes.before: and Benayahu the son of Yehoyada was over the army; and Tzadok and Abiathar were priests;
changes.after: and Benayahu the son of Yehoyada was over the army; and Tzadok and Evyatar were priests;

changes.before: Ben Deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
changes.after: Ben Deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beit Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;

changes.before: Shlomo built Gezer, and Beth Horon the lower,
changes.after: Shlomo built Gezer, and Beit Horon the lower,

changes.before: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
changes.after: Through Silvanos, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

changes.before: and another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
changes.after: and another company turned the way to Beit Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

changes.before: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude: and they came up, and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.
changes.after: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude: and they came up, and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beit Aven.

changes.before: So YHWH saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.
changes.after: So YHWH saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over by Beit Aven.

changes.before: and Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the priest of YHWH in Shilo, wearing an ephod. The people didn't know that Yonatan was gone.
changes.after: and Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Pinchas, the son of Eli, the priest of YHWH in Shilo, wearing an ephod. The people didn't know that Yonatan was gone.

changes.before: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to YHWH of Armies in Shilo. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to YHWH, were there.
changes.after: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to YHWH of Armies in Shilo. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Pinchas, priests to YHWH, were there.

changes.before: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after Dawid.
changes.after: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Evyatar, escaped, and fled after Dawid.

changes.before: Abiathar told Dawid that Shaul had slain YHWH's priests.
changes.after: Evyatar told Dawid that Shaul had slain YHWH's priests.

changes.before: Dawid said to Abiathar, I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Shaul: I have occasioned [the death] of all the persons of your father's house.
changes.after: Dawid said to Evyatar, I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Shaul: I have occasioned [the death] of all the persons of your father's house.

changes.before: It happened, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to Dawid to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
changes.after: It happened, when Evyatar the son of Ahimelech fled to Dawid to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.

changes.before: Dawid knew that Shaul was devising mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring here the ephod.
changes.after: Dawid knew that Shaul was devising mischief against him; and he said to Evyatar the priest, Bring here the ephod.

changes.before: Then answered Dawid and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Yoav, saying, Who will go down with me to Shaul to the camp? Abishai said, I will go down with you.
changes.after: Then answered Dawid and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Avishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Yoav, saying, Who will go down with me to Shaul to the camp? Avishai said, I will go down with you.

changes.before: So Dawid and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Shaul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay round about him.
changes.after: So Dawid and Avishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Shaul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay round about him.

changes.before: Then said Abishai to Dawid, Elohim has delivered up your enemy into your hand this day: now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.
changes.after: Then said Avishai to Dawid, Elohim has delivered up your enemy into your hand this day: now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.

changes.before: Dawid said to Abishai, Don't destroy him; for who can put forth his hand against YHWH's anointed, and be guiltless?
changes.after: Dawid said to Avishai, Don't destroy him; for who can put forth his hand against YHWH's anointed, and be guiltless?

changes.before: This shall be the sign to you, that shall come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they shall die both of them.
changes.after: This shall be the sign to you, that shall come on your two sons, on Hophni and Pinchas: in one day they shall die both of them.

changes.before: Dawid said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, Please bring me here the ephod. Abiathar brought there the ephod to Dawid.
changes.after: Dawid said to Evyatar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, Please bring me here the ephod. Evyatar brought there the ephod to Dawid.

changes.before: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth; and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
changes.after: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth; and they fastened his body to the wall of Beit She'an.

changes.before: all the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Shaul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
changes.after: all the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Shaul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beit She'an; and they came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

changes.before: The ark of Elohim was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
changes.after: The ark of Elohim was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Pinchas, were slain.

changes.before: The one who brought the news answered, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people, and your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of Elohim is taken.
changes.after: The one who brought the news answered, Israel is fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people, and your two sons also, Hophni and Pinchas, are dead, and the ark of Elohim is taken.

changes.before: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas' wife, was with child, near to be delivered: and when she heard the news that the ark of Elohim was taken, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and brought forth; for her pains came on her.
changes.after: His daughter-in-law, Pinchas' wife, was with child, near to be delivered: and when she heard the news that the ark of Elohim was taken, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and brought forth; for her pains came on her.

changes.before: So the people sent to Shilo; and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of YHWH of Armies, who sits [above] the cherubim: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of Elohim.
changes.after: So the people sent to Shilo; and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of YHWH of Armies, who sits [above] the cherubim: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Pinchas, were there with the ark of the covenant of Elohim.

changes.before: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh; they went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn't turn aside to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.
changes.after: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beit Shemesh; they went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn't turn aside to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beit Shemesh.

changes.before: They of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes, and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.
changes.after: They of Beit Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes, and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

changes.before: The cart came into the field of Yehoshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone: and they split the wood of the cart, and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to YHWH.
changes.after: The cart came into the field of Yehoshua of Beit Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone: and they split the wood of the cart, and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to YHWH.

changes.before: The Levites took down the ark of YHWH, and the coffer that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone: and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to YHWH.
changes.after: The Levites took down the ark of YHWH, and the coffer that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone: and the men of Beit Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to YHWH.

changes.before: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to YHWH: for Ashdod one, for Azzah one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;
changes.after: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to YHWH: for Ashdod one, for Azzah one, for Ashqelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

changes.before: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone, whereon they set down the ark of YHWH, [which stone remains] to this day in the field of Yehoshua of Beth Shemesh.
changes.after: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone, whereon they set down the ark of YHWH, [which stone remains] to this day in the field of Yehoshua of Beit Shemesh.

changes.before: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of YHWH, he struck of the people fifty thousand seventy men; and the people mourned, because YHWH had struck the people with a great slaughter.
changes.after: He struck of the men of Beit Shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of YHWH, he struck of the people fifty thousand seventy men; and the people mourned, because YHWH had struck the people with a great slaughter.

changes.before: The men of Beth Shemesh said, Who is able to stand before YHWH, this holy Elohim? and to whom shall he go up from us?
changes.after: The men of Beit Shemesh said, Who is able to stand before YHWH, this holy Elohim? and to whom shall he go up from us?

changes.before: Behold; if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great brokenness: but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us; it was a chance that happened to us."
changes.after: Behold; if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beit Shemesh, then he has done us this great brokenness: but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us; it was a chance that happened to us."

changes.before: The people of Israel went out of Mizpah, and pursued the Philistines, and struck them, until they came under Beth Kar.
changes.after: The people of Israel went out of Mizpah, and pursued the Philistines, and struck them, until they came under Beit Kar.

changes.before: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abijah: they were judges in Be'er Sheva.
changes.after: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Aviyah: they were judges in Be'er Sheva.

changes.before: Shaul, Silvanus, and Timotheos, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Cosmic Parent and Master Yeshua the Messiah: Grace to you and peace from God our Cosmic Parent and Master Yeshua the Messiah.
changes.after: Shaul, Silvanos, and Timotheos, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Cosmic Parent and Master Yeshua the Messiah: Grace to you and peace from God our Cosmic Parent and Master Yeshua the Messiah.

changes.before: After her he took Maacah the daughter of Avshalom; and she bore him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
changes.after: After her he took Maacah the daughter of Avshalom; and she bore him Aviyah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

changes.before: Rechavam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, [even] the prince among his brothers; for [he was minded] to make him king.
changes.after: Rechavam appointed Aviyah the son of Maacah to be chief, [even] the prince among his brothers; for [he was minded] to make him king.

changes.before: Rechavam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of Dawid: and Abijah his son reigned in his place.
changes.after: Rechavam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of Dawid: and Aviyah his son reigned in his place.

changes.before: In the eighteenth year of king Yerovam began Abijah to reign over Yehudah.
changes.after: In the eighteenth year of king Yerovam began Aviyah to reign over Yehudah.

changes.before: Then the people of Yehudah gave a shout: and as the people of Yehudah shouted, it happened, that Elohim struck Yerovam and all Israel before Abijah and Yehudah.
changes.after: Then the people of Yehudah gave a shout: and as the people of Yehudah shouted, it happened, that Elohim struck Yerovam and all Israel before Aviyah and Yehudah.

changes.before: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
changes.after: Aviyah and his people killed them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

changes.before: Abijah pursued after Yerovam, and took cities from him, Beit El with the towns of it, and Jeshanah with the towns of it, and Ephron with the towns of it.
changes.after: Aviyah pursued after Yerovam, and took cities from him, Beit El with the towns of it, and Jeshanah with the towns of it, and Ephron with the towns of it.

changes.before: Three years reigned he in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Yerovam.
changes.after: Three years reigned he in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Aviyah and Yerovam.

changes.before: Neither did Yerovam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and YHWH struck him, and he died.
changes.after: Neither did Yerovam recover strength again in the days of Aviyah: and YHWH struck him, and he died.

changes.before: But Abijah grew mighty, and took to himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons, and sixteen daughters.
changes.after: But Aviyah grew mighty, and took to himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons, and sixteen daughters.

changes.before: The rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
changes.after: The rest of the acts of Aviyah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.

changes.before: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: and Yerovam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.
changes.after: Aviyah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: and Yerovam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

changes.before: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Efrayim, and said, Hear me, Yerovam and all Israel:
changes.after: Aviyah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Efrayim, and said, Hear me, Yerovam and all Israel:

changes.before: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
changes.after: So Aviyah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

changes.before: There came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an army of a million troops, and three hundred chariots; and he came to Mareshah.
changes.after: There came out against them Zerach the Ethiopian with an army of a million troops, and three hundred chariots; and he came to Mareshah.

changes.before: and with them the Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
changes.after: and with them the Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adoniyahu, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Yoram, the priests.

changes.before: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of YHWH; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Yehudah, in all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and YHWH be with the good.
changes.after: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of YHWH; and Zebadiah the son of Yishmael, the ruler of the house of Yehudah, in all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and YHWH be with the good.

changes.before: Yehoshafat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid: and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
changes.after: Yehoshafat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid: and Yoram his son reigned in his place.

changes.before: YHWH stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians:
changes.after: YHWH stirred up against Yoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians:

changes.before: He had brothers, the sons of Yehoshafat: Azaryah, and Jehiel, and Zekharyah, and Azaryah, and Michael, and Shephatiah; all these were the sons of Yehoshafat king of Israel.
changes.after: He had brothers, the sons of Yehoshafat: Azaryah, and Jehiel, and Zekharyah, and Azaryah, and Mikha'el, and Shephatiah; all these were the sons of Yehoshafat king of Israel.

changes.before: Their father gave them great gifts, of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Yehudah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.
changes.after: Their father gave them great gifts, of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Yehudah: but the kingdom gave he to Yoram, because he was the firstborn.

changes.before: Now when Jehoram was risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and various also of the princes of Israel.
changes.after: Now when Yoram was risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and various also of the princes of Israel.

changes.before: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Yerushalayim.
changes.after: Yoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Yerushalayim.

changes.before: Then Jehoram passed over with his captains, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.
changes.after: Then Yoram passed over with his captains, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

changes.before: The inhabitants of Yerushalayim made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place; for the band of people who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yehudah reigned.
changes.after: The inhabitants of Yerushalayim made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place; for the band of people who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Yoram king of Yehudah reigned.

changes.before: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Yoash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king's sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Yehoyada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn't kill him.
changes.after: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Yoash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king's sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Yoram, the wife of Yehoyada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn't kill him.

changes.before: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Achav king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead: and the Syrians wounded Joram.
changes.after: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Yoram the son of Achav king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead: and the Syrians wounded Yoram.

changes.before: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. Azaryah the son of Jehoram king of Yehudah went down to see Jehoram the son of Achav in Jezreel, because he was sick.
changes.after: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. Azaryah the son of Yoram king of Yehudah went down to see Yoram the son of Achav in Jezreel, because he was sick.

changes.before: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of Elohim, in that he went to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Yehu the son of Nimshi, whom YHWH had anointed to cut off the house of Achav.
changes.after: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of Elohim, in that he went to Yoram: for when he was come, he went out with Yoram against Yehu the son of Nimshi, whom YHWH had anointed to cut off the house of Achav.

changes.before: In the seventh year Yehoyada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azaryah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azaryah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
changes.after: In the seventh year Yehoyada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azaryah the son of Jeroham, and Yishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azaryah the son of Oved, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

changes.before: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Yehudah, from Shomron even to Beth Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much spoil.
changes.after: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Yehudah, from Shomron even to Beit Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much spoil.

changes.before: So Yoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Yehudah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Yehudah.
changes.after: So Yoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Yehudah looked one another in the face at Beit Shemesh, which belongs to Yehudah.

changes.before: Yoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Yehudah, the son of Yoash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh, and brought him to Yerushalayim, and broke down the wall of Yerushalayim from the gate of Efrayim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
changes.after: Yoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Yehudah, the son of Yoash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beit Shemesh, and brought him to Yerushalayim, and broke down the wall of Yerushalayim from the gate of Efrayim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

changes.before: [He took] all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of Elohim with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Shomron.
changes.after: [He took] all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of Elohim with Oved-Edom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Shomron.

changes.before: All the people of Yehudah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
changes.after: All the people of Yehudah took Uzziyah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.

changes.before: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men, who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.
changes.after: Moreover Uzziyah had an army of fighting men, who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.

changes.before: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, and spears, and helmets, and coats of mail, and bows, and stones for slinging.
changes.after: Uzziyah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, and spears, and helmets, and coats of mail, and bows, and stones for slinging.

changes.before: and they withstood Uzziah the king, and said to him, It pertains not to you, Uzziah, to burn incense to YHWH, but to the priests the sons of Aharon, who are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for you have trespassed; neither shall it be for your honor from YHWH Elohim.

changes.before: Then Uzziah was angry; and he had a censer in his hand to burn incense; and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke forth in his forehead before the priests in the house of YHWH, beside the altar of incense.
changes.after: Then Uzziyah was angry; and he had a censer in his hand to burn incense; and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke forth in his forehead before the priests in the house of YHWH, beside the altar of incense.

changes.after: Uzziyah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of YHWH: and Yotam his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.

changes.before: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Yeshayahu the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
changes.after: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziyah, first and last, did Yeshayahu the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.

changes.before: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his place.
changes.after: So Uzziyah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Yotam his son reigned in his place.

changes.before: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Jechiliah, of Yerushalayim.
changes.after: Sixteen years old was Uzziyah when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Jechiliah, of Yerushalayim.

changes.before: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entrance of Mitzrayim; for he grew exceeding strong.
changes.after: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziyah: and his name spread abroad even to the entrance of Mitzrayim; for he grew exceeding strong.

changes.before: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Yerushalayim at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning [of the wall], and fortified them.
changes.after: Moreover Uzziyah built towers in Yerushalayim at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning [of the wall], and fortified them.

changes.before: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Jerushah the daughter of Tzadok.
changes.after: Yotam was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Jerushah the daughter of Tzadok.

changes.before: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, according to all that his father Uzziah had done: however he didn't enter into the temple of YHWH. The people did yet corruptly.
changes.after: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, according to all that his father Uzziyah had done: however he didn't enter into the temple of YHWH. The people did yet corruptly.

changes.before: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before YHWH his God.
changes.after: So Yotam became mighty, because he ordered his ways before YHWH his God.

changes.before: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Yehudah.
changes.after: Now the rest of the acts of Yotam, and all his wars, and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Yehudah.

changes.before: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid: and Achaz his son reigned in his place.
changes.after: Yotam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid: and Achaz his son reigned in his place.

changes.before: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland, and of the South of Yehudah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, and Aijalon, and Gederoth, and Soco with the towns of it, and Timnah with the towns of it, Gimzo also and the towns of it: and they lived there.
changes.after: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland, and of the South of Yehudah, and had taken Beit Shemesh, and Aijalon, and Gederoth, and Soco with the towns of it, and Timnah with the towns of it, Gimzo also and the towns of it: and they lived there.

changes.before: Chizkiyahu began to reign when he was twenty-five years old; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zekharyah.
changes.after: Chizkiyahu began to reign when he was twenty-five years old; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Aviyah, the daughter of Zekharyah.

changes.before: Also he built Beth Horon the upper, and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
changes.after: Also he built Beit Horon the upper, and Beit Horon the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

changes.before: For the Son of God, Yeshua the Messiah, who was preached among you by us, by me, Silvanus, and Timotheos, was not "Yes and no," but in him is "Yes."
changes.after: For the Son of God, Yeshua the Messiah, who was preached among you by us, by me, Silvanos, and Timotheos, was not "Yes and no," but in him is "Yes."

changes.after: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Yoram, sister of Ahaziah, took Yoash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king's sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, [and put them] in the bedchamber; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain;

changes.before: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.
changes.after: Yoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

changes.after: In the seventh year of Yehu began Yoash to reign; and he reigned forty years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Zibiah of Be'er Sheva.

changes.before: Jehoash did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH all his days in which Yehoyada the priest instructed him.
changes.after: Yoash did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH all his days in which Yehoyada the priest instructed him.

changes.before: Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the holy things that is brought into the house of YHWH, in current money, the money of the persons for whom each a person is rated, and all the money that it comes into anyone's heart to bring into the house of YHWH,
changes.after: Yoash said to the priests, All the money of the holy things that is brought into the house of YHWH, in current money, the money of the persons for whom each a person is rated, and all the money that it comes into anyone's heart to bring into the house of YHWH,

changes.before: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
changes.after: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Yoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

changes.before: Then king Jehoash called for Yehoyada the priest, and for the [other] priests, and said to them, Why don't you repair the breaches of the house? now therefore take no [more] money from your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
changes.after: Then king Yoash called for Yehoyada the priest, and for the [other] priests, and said to them, Why don't you repair the breaches of the house? now therefore take no [more] money from your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

changes.before: In the thirty-seventh year of Yoash king of Yehudah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Shomron, [and reigned] sixteen years.
changes.after: In the thirty-seventh year of Yoash king of Yehudah began Yoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Shomron, [and reigned] sixteen years.

changes.before: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Yoash strike him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
changes.after: Yoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Yoash strike him, and recovered the cities of Israel.

changes.after: But Amaziah would not hear. So Yoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Yehudah looked one another in the face at Beit Shemesh, which belongs to Yehudah.

changes.after: Yoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Yehudah, the son of Yoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beit Shemesh, and came to Yerushalayim, and broke down the wall of Yerushalayim from the gate of Efrayim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

changes.before: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Yehudah, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
changes.after: Now the rest of the acts of Yoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Yehudah, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

changes.before: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Shomron with the kings of Israel; and Yerovam his son reigned in his place.
changes.after: Yoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Shomron with the kings of Israel; and Yerovam his son reigned in his place.

changes.before: Amaziah the son of Yoash king of Yehudah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
changes.after: Amaziah the son of Yoash king of Yehudah lived after the death of Yoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

changes.before: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the word of YHWH, the God of Israel, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was of Gath Hepher.
changes.after: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the word of YHWH, the God of Israel, which he spoke by his servant Yonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was of Gath Hepher.

changes.before: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Yehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
changes.after: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Yoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Yehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

changes.before: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Yehudah, saying, The thistle that was in Levanon sent to the cedar that was in Levanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son as wife: and there passed by a wild animal that was in Levanon, and trod down the thistle.
changes.after: Yoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Yehudah, saying, The thistle that was in Levanon sent to the cedar that was in Levanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son as wife: and there passed by a wild animal that was in Levanon, and trod down the thistle.

changes.before: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Yehudah; and he reigned the space of a month in Shomron.
changes.after: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziyah king of Yehudah; and he reigned the space of a month in Shomron.

changes.before: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and struck him, and killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
changes.after: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and struck him, and killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Yotam the son of Uzziyah.

changes.before: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Yehudah to reign.
changes.after: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Yotam the son of Uzziyah king of Yehudah to reign.

changes.before: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH; he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
changes.after: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH; he did according to all that his father Uzziyah had done.

changes.before: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yehudah?
changes.after: Now the rest of the acts of Yotam, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yehudah?

changes.after: Yotam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid his father: and Achaz his son reigned in his place.

changes.before: So he died according to the word of YHWH which Eliyahu had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Yehoshafat king of Yehudah; because he had no son.

changes.after: Now Yoram the son of Achav began to reign over Israel in Shomron in the eighteenth year of Yehoshafat king of Yehudah, and reigned twelve years.

changes.after: King Yoram went out of Shomron at that time, and mustered all Israel.

changes.before: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Achav king of Israel, Yehoshafat being then king of Yehudah, Jehoram the son of Yehoshafat king of Yehudah began to reign.
changes.after: In the fifth year of Yoram the son of Achav king of Israel, Yehoshafat being then king of Yehudah, Yoram the son of Yehoshafat king of Yehudah began to reign.

changes.after: The rest of the acts of Yoram, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yehudah?

changes.after: In the twelfth year of Yoram the son of Achav king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Yoram king of Yehudah begin to reign.

changes.after: He went with Yoram the son of Achav to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead: and the Syrians wounded Yoram.
