changes.before: Jethro said, "Blessed be YHWH, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
changes.after: Yitro said, "Blessed be YHWH, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

changes.before: Jethro, Moshe' father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for Elohim. Aharon came with all of the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moshe' father-in-law before Elohim.
changes.after: Yitro, Moshe' father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for Elohim. Aharon came with all of the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moshe' father-in-law before Elohim.

changes.before: Jethro, Moshe' father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moshe' wife, after he had sent her away,
changes.after: Yitro, Moshe' father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moshe' wife, after he had sent her away,

changes.before: Jethro, Moshe' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moshe into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of Elohim.
changes.after: Yitro, Moshe' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moshe into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of Elohim.

changes.before: He said to Moshe, I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.
changes.after: He said to Moshe, I, your father-in-law Yitro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.

changes.before: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which YHWH had done to Israel, in that YHWH had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
changes.after: Yitro rejoiced for all the goodness which YHWH had done to Israel, in that YHWH had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

changes.before: "You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, 'HOLY TO YAHWEH.'
changes.after: "You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, 'HOLY TO YHWH.'

changes.before: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it a writing, like the engravings of a signet: "HOLY TO YAHWEH."
changes.after: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it a writing, like the engravings of a signet: "HOLY TO YHWH."

changes.before: Now Moshe was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to Elohim's mountain, to Horeb.
changes.after: Now Moshe was keeping the flock of Yitro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to Elohim's mountain, to Horeb.

changes.before: Moshe went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, "Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Mitzrayim, and see whether they are still alive." Jethro said to Moshe, "Go in peace."
changes.after: Moshe went and returned to Yitro his father-in-law, and said to him, "Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Mitzrayim, and see whether they are still alive." Yitro said to Moshe, "Go in peace."

changes.before: These are the heads of their fathers' houses. The sons of Reuven the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuven.
changes.after: These are the heads of their fathers' houses. The sons of Reuven the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Chetzron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuven.

changes.before: Aharon took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
changes.after: Aharon took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadav, the sister of Nachshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

changes.before: Eleazar Aharon's son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites according to their families.
changes.after: Eleazar Aharon's son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Pinchas. These are the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites according to their families.

changes.before: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.
changes.after: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Kena'an, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

changes.before: Your elder sister is Shomron, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
changes.after: Your elder sister is Shomron, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sedom and her daughters.

changes.before: As I live, says YHWH God, Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
changes.after: As I live, says YHWH God, Sedom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

changes.before: Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
changes.after: Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sedom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

changes.before: I will turn again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Shomron and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives in the midst of them;
changes.after: I will turn again their captivity, the captivity of Sedom and her daughters, and the captivity of Shomron and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives in the midst of them;

changes.before: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate; and Shomron and her daughters shall return to their former estate; and you and your daughters shall return to your former estate.
changes.after: Your sisters, Sedom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate; and Shomron and her daughters shall return to their former estate; and you and your daughters shall return to your former estate.

changes.before: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
changes.after: For your sister Sedom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

changes.before: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
changes.after: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beit HaYeshimot, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

changes.before: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, and Eliyahu, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
changes.after: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, and Eliyahu, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziyah.

changes.before: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
changes.after: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Yishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

changes.before: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekhai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
changes.after: who came with Zerubavel, Jeshua, Nechemyah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekhai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

changes.before: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and their brothers the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and their brothers, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moshe the person of Elohim.
changes.after: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and their brothers the priests, and Zerubavel the son of She'altiel, and their brothers, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moshe the person of Elohim.

changes.before: Now in the second year of their coming to the house of Elohim at Yerushalayim, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who were come out of the captivity to Yerushalayim, and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of the house of YHWH.
changes.after: Now in the second year of their coming to the house of Elohim at Yerushalayim, in the second month, began Zerubavel the son of She'altiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who were come out of the captivity to Yerushalayim, and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of the house of YHWH.

changes.before: then they drew near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers' [houses], and said to them, Let us build with you; for we seek your God, as you do; and we sacrifice to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Ashur, who brought us up here.
changes.after: then they drew near to Zerubavel, and to the heads of fathers' [houses], and said to them, Let us build with you; for we seek your God, as you do; and we sacrifice to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Ashur, who brought us up here.

changes.before: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers' [houses] of Israel, said to them, You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to YHWH, the God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Paras has commanded us.
changes.after: But Zerubavel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers' [houses] of Israel, said to them, You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to YHWH, the God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Paras has commanded us.

changes.before: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of Elohim which is at Yerushalayim; and with them were the prophets of Elohim, helping them.
changes.after: Then rose up Zerubavel the son of She'altiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of Elohim which is at Yerushalayim; and with them were the prophets of Elohim, helping them.

changes.before: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aharon the chief priest;
changes.after: the son of Abishua, the son of Pinchas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aharon the chief priest;

changes.before: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Dani'el. Of the sons of Dawid, Hattush.
changes.after: Of the sons of Pinchas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Dani'el. Of the sons of Dawid, Hattush.

changes.before: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriyah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levite;
changes.after: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriyah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Pinchas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levite;

changes.before: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.
changes.after: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Mikha'el; and with him eighty males.

changes.before: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
changes.after: Then I came to the regions of Aram and Cilicia.

changes.before: Canaan became the father of Tzidon (his firstborn), Heth,
changes.after: Kena'an became the father of Tzidon (his firstborn), Heth,

changes.before: The border of the Canaanites was from Tzidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Azzah—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
changes.after: The border of the Canaanites was from Tzidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Azzah—as you go toward Sedom, Amora, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

changes.before: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
changes.after: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Kena'an.

changes.before: Terah took Avram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Avram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
changes.after: Terah took Avram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Avram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Kena'an. They came to Haran and lived there.

changes.before: Avram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.
changes.after: Avram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Kena'an. They entered into the land of Kena'an.

changes.before: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Yarden, that it was well-watered everywhere, before YHWH destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of YHWH, like the land of Mitzrayim, as you go to Zoar.
changes.after: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Yarden, that it was well-watered everywhere, before YHWH destroyed Sedom and Amora, like the garden of YHWH, like the land of Mitzrayim, as you go to Zoar.

changes.before: Avram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
changes.after: Avram lived in the land of Kena'an, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sedom.

changes.before: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against YHWH.
changes.after: Now the men of Sedom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against YHWH.

changes.before: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.
changes.after: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sedom and Amora fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

changes.before: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.
changes.after: They took all the goods of Sedom and Amora, and all their food, and went their way.

changes.before: They took Lot, Avram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
changes.after: They took Lot, Avram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sedom, and his goods, and departed.

changes.before: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
changes.after: The king of Sedom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

changes.before: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
changes.after: they made war with Bera, king of Sedom; Birsha, king of Amora; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

changes.before: The king of Sodom said to Avram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”
changes.after: The king of Sedom said to Avram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

changes.before: Avram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to YHWH, Elohim Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
changes.after: Avram said to the king of Sedom, “I have lifted up my hand to YHWH, Elohim Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

changes.before: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar), went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim.
changes.after: The king of Sedom, and the king of Amora, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar), went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim.

changes.before: Sarai, Avram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Avram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Avram her husband to be his wife.
changes.after: Sarai, Avram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Avram had lived ten years in the land of Kena'an, and gave her to Avram her husband to be his wife.

changes.before: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
changes.after: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Kena'an, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

changes.before: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Avraham went with them to see them on their way.
changes.after: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sedom. Avraham went with them to see them on their way.

changes.before: YHWH said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
changes.after: YHWH said, “Because the cry of Sedom and Amora is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

changes.before: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Avraham stood yet before YHWH.
changes.after: The men turned from there, and went toward Sedom, but Avraham stood yet before YHWH.

changes.before: YHWH said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
changes.after: YHWH said, “If I find in Sedom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

changes.before: The two messengers came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
changes.after: The two messengers came to Sedom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sedom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

changes.before: Then YHWH rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from YHWH out of the heavens.
changes.after: Then YHWH rained on Sedom and on Amora sulfur and fire from YHWH out of the heavens.

changes.before: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
changes.after: He looked toward Sedom and Amora, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

changes.before: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
changes.after: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sedom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

changes.before: After this, Avraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Chevron), in the land of Canaan.
changes.after: After this, Avraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Chevron), in the land of Kena'an.

changes.before: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Chevron), in the land of Canaan. Avraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
changes.after: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Chevron), in the land of Kena'an. Avraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

changes.before: Rivqah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the person, to the spring.
changes.after: Rivqah had a brother, and his name was Lavan. Lavan ran out to the person, to the spring.

changes.before: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”
changes.after: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Lavan said, “Speak on.”

changes.before: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from YHWH. We can’t speak to you bad or good.
changes.after: Then Lavan and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from YHWH. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

changes.before: Yitzhak was forty years old when he took Rivqah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
changes.after: Yitzhak was forty years old when he took Rivqah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Lavan the Syrian, to be his wife.

changes.before: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
changes.after: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Lavan, my brother, in Haran.

changes.before: Yitzhak called Yaakov, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
changes.after: Yitzhak called Yaakov, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Kena'an.

changes.before: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
changes.after: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Lavan, your mother’s brother.

changes.before: Yitzhak sent Yaakov away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rivqah, Yaakov’s and Esav’s mother.
changes.after: Yitzhak sent Yaakov away. He went to Paddan Aram to Lavan, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rivqah, Yaakov’s and Esav’s mother.

changes.before: Now Esav saw that Yitzhak had blessed Yaakov and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”
changes.after: Now Esav saw that Yitzhak had blessed Yaakov and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Kena'an;”

changes.before: Esav saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Yitzhak, his father.
changes.after: Esav saw that the daughters of Kena'an didn’t please Yitzhak, his father.

changes.before: When Yaakov saw Rakhel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Yaakov went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
changes.after: When Yaakov saw Rakhel the daughter of Lavan, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Lavan, his mother’s brother, Yaakov went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Lavan his mother’s brother.

changes.before: When Laban heard the news of Yaakov, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Yaakov, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Yaakov told Laban all these things.
changes.after: When Lavan heard the news of Yaakov, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Yaakov, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Yaakov told Lavan all these things.

changes.before: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Yaakov stayed with him for a month.
changes.after: Lavan said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Yaakov stayed with him for a month.

changes.before: Laban said to Yaakov, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
changes.after: Lavan said to Yaakov, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

changes.before: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rakhel.
changes.after: Lavan had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rakhel.

changes.before: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
changes.after: Lavan said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

changes.before: Yaakov said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
changes.after: Yaakov said to Lavan, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

changes.before: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
changes.after: Lavan gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

changes.before: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
changes.after: Lavan gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

changes.before: In the morning, look, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rakhel? Why then have you deceived me?”
changes.after: In the morning, look, it was Leah! He said to Lavan, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rakhel? Why then have you deceived me?”

changes.before: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
changes.after: Lavan said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

changes.before: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rakhel to be her servant.
changes.after: Lavan gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rakhel to be her servant.

changes.before: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
changes.after: He said to them, “Do you know Lavan, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

changes.before: When Rakhel had borne Yosef, Yaakov said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
changes.after: When Rakhel had borne Yosef, Yaakov said to Lavan, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

changes.before: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that YHWH has blessed me for your sake.”
changes.after: Lavan said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that YHWH has blessed me for your sake.”

changes.before: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Yaakov said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.
changes.after: Lavan said, “What shall I give you?” Yaakov said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

changes.before: Laban said, “Look, let it be according to your word.”
changes.after: Lavan said, “Look, let it be according to your word.”

changes.before: He set three days’ journey between himself and Yaakov, and Yaakov fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
changes.after: He set three days’ journey between himself and Yaakov, and Yaakov fed the rest of Lavan’s flocks.

changes.after: The vision of Yeshayahu the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Yehudah and Yerushalayim, in the days of Uzziyah, Yotam, Achaz, and Chizkiyahu, kings of Yehudah.

changes.before: Hear the word of YHWH, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
changes.after: Hear the word of YHWH, you rulers of Sedom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Amora!

changes.before: Unless YHWH of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom; we would have been like Gomorrah.
changes.after: Unless YHWH of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sedom; we would have been like Amora.

changes.before: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. YHWH has ordered the destruction of Canaan's strongholds.
changes.after: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. YHWH has ordered the destruction of Kena'an's strongholds.

changes.before: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don't hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.
changes.after: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sedom. They don't hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

changes.before: In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw YHWH sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
changes.after: In the year that king Uzziyah died, I saw YHWH sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

changes.before: It happened in the days of Achaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Yehudah, that Rezin the king of Aram, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Yerushalayim to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
changes.after: It happened in the days of Achaz the son of Yotam, the son of Uzziyah, king of Yehudah, that Rezin the king of Aram, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Yerushalayim to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

changes.before: In the prophets of Yerushalayim also I have seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies; and they strengthen the hands of people who act from brokenness, so that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them become to me as Sodom, and the inhabitants of it as Gomorrah.
changes.after: In the prophets of Yerushalayim also I have seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies; and they strengthen the hands of people who act from brokenness, so that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them become to me as Sedom, and the inhabitants of it as Amora.

changes.before: YHWH shown me, and behold, two baskets of figs set before the temple of YHWH, after that Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Yehudah, and the princes of Yehudah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Yerushalayim, and had brought them to Bavel.
changes.after: YHWH shown me, and behold, two baskets of figs set before the temple of YHWH, after that Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel had carried away captive Yekhonyahu the son of Jehoiakim, king of Yehudah, and the princes of Yehudah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Yerushalayim, and had brought them to Bavel.

changes.before: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of the Uz, and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
changes.after: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of the Uz, and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ashqelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

changes.before: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel didn't take, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Yehudah, from Yerushalayim to Bavel, and all the nobles of Yehudah and Yerushalayim;
changes.after: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel didn't take, when he carried away captive Yekhonyahu the son of Jehoiakim, king of Yehudah, from Yerushalayim to Bavel, and all the nobles of Yehudah and Yerushalayim;

changes.before: and I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Yehudah, with all the captives of Yehudah, who went to Bavel, says YHWH; for I will break the yoke of the king of Bavel.
changes.after: and I will bring again to this place Yekhonyahu the son of Jehoiakim, king of Yehudah, with all the captives of Yehudah, who went to Bavel, says YHWH; for I will break the yoke of the king of Bavel.

changes.before: (after that Jeconiah the king, and the queen mother, and the eunuchs, [and] the princes of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and the craftsmen, and the smiths, were departed from Yerushalayim),
changes.after: (after that Yekhonyahu the king, and the queen mother, and the eunuchs, [and] the princes of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and the craftsmen, and the smiths, were departed from Yerushalayim),

changes.before: and said to him, Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn't believe them.
changes.after: and said to him, Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Yishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn't believe them.

changes.before: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no one shall know it: why should they take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Yehudah perish?
changes.after: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Please let me go, and I will kill Yishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no one shall know it: why should they take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Yehudah perish?

changes.before: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, You shall not do this thing; for you speak falsely of Ishmael.
changes.after: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, You shall not do this thing; for you speak falsely of Yishmael.

changes.before: then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, [to wit], Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Yonatan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
changes.after: then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, [to wit], Yishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Yonatan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

changes.before: Now it happened in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal and [one of] the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.
changes.after: Now it happened in the seventh month, that Yishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal and [one of] the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.

changes.before: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people who were in Mizpah, even the king's daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam; Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.
changes.after: Then Yishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people who were in Mizpah, even the king's daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam; Yishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

changes.before: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the brokenness that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
changes.after: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the brokenness that Yishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

changes.before: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.
changes.after: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Yishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

changes.before: Now it happened that, when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.
changes.after: Now it happened that, when all the people who were with Yishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.

changes.before: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.
changes.after: So all the people who Yishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

changes.before: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.
changes.after: But Yishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.

changes.before: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, [to wit], the men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon:
changes.after: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Yishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, [to wit], the men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon:

changes.before: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Bavel made governor over the land.
changes.after: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Yishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Bavel made governor over the land.

changes.before: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten people who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and killed him, whom the king of Bavel had made governor over the land.
changes.after: Then arose Yishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten people who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and killed him, whom the king of Bavel had made governor over the land.

changes.before: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with him, [to wit], with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, the men of war.
changes.after: Yishmael also killed all the Jews who were with him, [to wit], with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, the men of war.

changes.before: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it happened, as he met them, he said to them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.
changes.after: Yishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it happened, as he met them, he said to them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

changes.before: It was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, [and cast them] into the midst of the pit, he, and the people who were with him.
changes.after: It was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Yishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, [and cast them] into the midst of the pit, he, and the people who were with him.

changes.before: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, Don't kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he stopped, and didn't kill them among their brothers.
changes.after: But ten men were found among those who said to Yishmael, Don't kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he stopped, and didn't kill them among their brothers.

changes.before: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (the same was who which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.
changes.after: Now the pit in which Yishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (the same was who which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Yishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.

changes.before: He shall also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh, that is in the land of Mitzrayim; and the houses of the gods of Mitzrayim shall he burn with fire.
changes.after: He shall also break the pillars of Beit Shemesh, that is in the land of Mitzrayim; and the houses of the gods of Mitzrayim shall he burn with fire.

changes.before: Baldness is come on Azzah; Ashkelon is brought to nothing, the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut yourself?
changes.after: Baldness is come on Azzah; Ashqelon is brought to nothing, the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut yourself?

changes.before: How can you be quiet, seeing YHWH has given you a charge? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there has he appointed it.
changes.after: How can you be quiet, seeing YHWH has given you a charge? Against Ashqelon, and against the seashore, there has he appointed it.

changes.before: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities of it, says YHWH, no one shall dwell there, neither shall any child of humanity sojourn therein.
changes.after: As in the overthrow of Sedom and Amora and the neighbor cities of it, says YHWH, no one shall dwell there, neither shall any child of humanity sojourn therein.

changes.before: As when Elohim overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities of it, says YHWH, so shall no one dwell there, neither shall any child of humanity sojourn therein.
changes.after: As when Elohim overthrew Sedom and Amora and the neighbor cities of it, says YHWH, so shall no one dwell there, neither shall any child of humanity sojourn therein.

changes.before: Now the word of YHWH came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
changes.after: Now the word of YHWH came to Yonah the son of Amittai, saying,

changes.before: So they took up Jonah, and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.
changes.after: So they took up Yonah, and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.

changes.before: YHWH prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
changes.after: YHWH prepared a great fish to swallow up Yonah, and Yonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

changes.before: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of YHWH. He went down to Yafo, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of YHWH.
changes.after: But Yonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of YHWH. He went down to Yafo, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of YHWH.

changes.before: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried everyone to their god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea, to lighten it. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship, and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.
changes.after: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried everyone to their god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea, to lighten it. But Yonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship, and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.

changes.before: They all said to each other, "Come, let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this brokenness is on us." So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
changes.after: They all said to each other, "Come, let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this brokenness is on us." So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Yonah.

changes.before: Then Jonah prayed to YHWH, his God, out of the fish's belly.
changes.after: Then Yonah prayed to YHWH, his God, out of the fish's belly.

changes.before: YHWH spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
changes.after: YHWH spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Yonah on the dry land.

changes.before: The word of YHWH came to Jonah the second time, saying,
changes.after: The word of YHWH came to Yonah the second time, saying,

changes.before: So Jonah arose, and went to Ninveh, according to the word of YHWH. Now Ninveh was an exceedingly great city, three days' journey across.
changes.after: So Yonah arose, and went to Ninveh, according to the word of YHWH. Now Ninveh was an exceedingly great city, three days' journey across.

changes.before: Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried out, and said, "Yet forty days, and Ninveh shall be overthrown!"
changes.after: Yonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried out, and said, "Yet forty days, and Ninveh shall be overthrown!"

changes.before: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
changes.after: But it displeased Yonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

changes.before: Then Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth, and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.
changes.after: Then Yonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth, and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.

changes.before: YHWH Elohim prepared a vine, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head, to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.
changes.after: YHWH Elohim prepared a vine, and made it to come up over Yonah, that it might be a shade over his head, to deliver him from his discomfort. So Yonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.

changes.before: It happened, when the sun arose, that Elohim prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah's head, so that he fainted, and requested for himself that he might die, and said, "It is better for me to die than to live."
changes.after: It happened, when the sun arose, that Elohim prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Yonah's head, so that he fainted, and requested for himself that he might die, and said, "It is better for me to die than to live."

changes.before: Elohim said to Jonah, "Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?" He said, "I am right to be angry, even to death."
changes.after: Elohim said to Yonah, "Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?" He said, "I am right to be angry, even to death."

changes.before: YHWH confused them before Israel, and YHWH killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah, and to Makkedah.
changes.after: YHWH confused them before Israel, and YHWH killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beit Horon, and struck them to Azekah, and to Makkedah.

changes.before: It happened, as they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, that YHWH cast down great stones from the heavens on them to Azekah, and they died: they were more who died with the hailstones than they whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.
changes.after: It happened, as they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beit Horon, that YHWH cast down great stones from the heavens on them to Azekah, and they died: they were more who died with the hailstones than they whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

changes.before: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
changes.after: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beit HaYeshimot; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

changes.before: and Beth Peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth,
changes.after: and Beit Peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beit HaYeshimot,

changes.before: and in the valley, Beth Haram, and Beth Nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Yarden and the border [of it], to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Yarden eastward.
changes.after: and in the valley, Beth Haram, and Beit Nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Yarden and the border [of it], to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Yarden eastward.

changes.before: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Yehoshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,
changes.after: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Kena'an, which Eleazar the priest, and Yehoshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,

changes.before: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim on the north (the same is Chesalon), and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;
changes.after: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim on the north (the same is Chesalon), and went down to Beit Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

changes.before: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron (the same is Hazor),
changes.after: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth, Chetzron (the same is Hazor),

changes.before: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, and went up to Addar, and turned about to Karka;
changes.after: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Chetzron, and went up to Addar, and turned about to Karka;

changes.before: and Gederoth, Beth Dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
changes.after: and Gederoth, Beit Dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

changes.before: and Janim, and Beth Tappuah, and Aphekah,
changes.after: and Janim, and Beit Tappuach, and Aphekah,

changes.before: and the border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuven;
changes.after: and the border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beit HaAravah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuven;

changes.before: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, and Secacah,
changes.after: In the wilderness, Beit HaAravah, Middin, and Secacah,

changes.before: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, even to Gezer; and the goings out of it were at the sea.
changes.after: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beit Horon the lower, even to Gezer; and the goings out of it were at the sea.

changes.before: The border of the children of Efrayim according to their families was [thus]: the border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper;
changes.after: The border of the children of Efrayim according to their families was [thus]: the border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beit Horon the upper;

changes.before: Menashe had in Yissakhar and in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns, even the three heights.
changes.after: Menashe had in Yissakhar and in Asher Beit She'an and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns, even the three heights.

changes.before: The children of Yosef said, The hill country is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and they who are in the valley of Jezreel.
changes.after: The children of Yosef said, The hill country is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are in Beit She'an and its towns, and they who are in the valley of Jezreel.

changes.before: Their border on the north quarter was from the Yarden; and the border went up to the side of Yericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward; and the goings out of it were at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
changes.after: Their border on the north quarter was from the Yarden; and the border went up to the side of Yericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward; and the goings out of it were at the wilderness of Beit Aven.

changes.before: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (the same is Beit El), southward; and the border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.
changes.after: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (the same is Beit El), southward; and the border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beit Horon the lower.

changes.before: The border extended [there], and turned about on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and the goings out of it were at Kiriath Baal (the same is Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Yehudah: this was the west quarter.
changes.after: The border extended [there], and turned about on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beit Horon southward; and the goings out of it were at Kiriath Baal (the same is Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Yehudah: this was the west quarter.

changes.before: and Beth Arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beit El,
changes.after: and Beit HaAravah, and Zemaraim, and Beit El,

changes.before: and the border reached to Tabor, and Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh; and the goings out of their border were at the Yarden: sixteen cities with their villages.
